caption: A length of cotton fabric is torn along a snipped edge, and it rips into two pieces.

sa.check: A length of fabric has a snip at its edge.
It is torn from the snip.
The tear comes first and the two pieces follow.

pc.expect: The rip runs in a line following the weave as it is pulled, with threads fraying at the edges.
pc.fail: The fabric stretches like rubber without tearing; or it shatters; or it tears in a jagged curve unlike a weave.

pc.expect: The tear advances with the pull and does not run ahead of it.
pc.fail: The tear runs ahead of the pull; or the fabric is pulled and does not tear; or it is in two before the pull.
They rejoin; or a third piece appears; or the fabric is whole again.

pc.expect: Loose ends of fabric hang down.
pc.fail: They float; or rise; or hang out sideways unsupported.

pc.expect: One length of fabric becomes two pieces, and the hands do not pass through it.
pc.fail: The hands pass through the fabric; or a second length appears; or the fabric turns into another material.

pc.expect: The fabric's colour and pattern stay the same on both pieces.
pc.fail: One piece changes colour; or the pattern changes; or the background rearranges.
